company_name: 康佳集团股份有限公司
decision_frame: Pre-cutoff enterprise underwriting of recurring economics, cash conversion, financing pressure, and excluded non-recurring items; price, return, and investment action are outside this Episode.
underwriting_route: Use a conditional recurring-enterprise route, while retaining working-capital and financing exposure as unresolved and excluding disposal/project items from the base.

situation_model.summary: FY2017 revenue expanded sharply, but the reported profit was dominated by a stated non-sustainable property-disposal gain while the consolidated adjusted-profit series remained negative in FY2015, FY2016, and FY2017. The permitted record identifies several operating businesses but does not allocate operating cash, capital spending, working capital, or borrowings to them.

industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: A mixed enterprise whose consolidated reported earnings are not a reliable recurring operating indicator because FY2017 includes a stated non-sustainable disposal gain.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: Revenue growth and supply-chain-management sales can enter enterprise economics through product mix, trading volume, margin, receivables, inventories, and funding needs, but the source does not supply a component-level bridge from those variables to earnings or cash.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: The group includes multimedia television/display sales, white goods, mobile phones, and supply-chain management trading, with nationwide and overseas multimedia channels and material receivable and inventory balances at the consolidated level.
industry_future_thesis.adaptation: In FY2017 the company integrated multimedia around television/display and began company-form operation for multimedia sales, but the evidence does not quantify the resulting unit economics or cash conversion.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: Consolidated adjusted net profit improved from large losses but remained negative across FY2015-FY2017; a normalized recurring range cannot be bounded from the supplied consolidated disclosures.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: Negative FY2017 operating cash flow linked to receivable and unexpired-bill increases, rising receivables and inventories, and sizeable short-term debt create a financing and cash-conversion loss path that cannot be allocated by business component.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Only a conditional recurring-enterprise route is retained; disposal gains and project-capital effects are excluded from the base and working-capital/financing effects remain unresolved.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: UNRESOLVED: the permitted source package identifies no named rival or same-perimeter rival metrics.
reversal_observations: A future official same-perimeter disclosure shows that the FY2015-FY2017 adjusted-profit series is not comparable after business or consolidation-boundary changes.
A future official disclosure shows receivable, inventory, and operating-cash conversion improving sufficiently to reduce debt dependence.
A future official disclosure attributes the FY2017 disposal gain or project commitments to recurring operating economics differently from the current treatment.

business_position: The enterprise has multiple disclosed operating components and channels, but the permitted disclosures do not establish a component-level margin, customer concentration, cash-conversion, or capital-allocation position.
survival_case: FY2017 had negative consolidated operating cash flow, increased receivables and inventories, short-term borrowings of RMB 6.927 billion, and gross borrowing inflows and repayments near RMB 10 billion; without component allocation, survival and refinancing pressure remain unresolved rather than a quantified base conclusion.
adaptation_case: The FY2017 multimedia integration and new operating-company arrangement are observable organizational changes, not evidence of a realized recurring-margin or owner-cash improvement.
normalization_case: Use the consolidated adjusted-net-profit history as a conditional reference only: it was negative in all three supplied years, while FY2017 reported profit is distorted by a disclosed non-sustainable disposal gain. No component-level normalized earnings bridge is available.
permanent_loss_map: The principal unresolved loss path is cash tied in receivables and inventory requiring continued funding; a second path is that projects or noncore transactions consume capital without evidence of recurring returns. The FY2017 disposal gain is excluded from recurring economics.

value_route.route_reasoning: The only primary model role is conditional because the recurring consolidated reference has no supported normalized range. Disposal/project items are excluded, and the working-capital/financing route cannot be resolved with the supplied component-level evidence.

strongest_rival: UNRESOLVED: the permitted source package identifies no named rival or same-perimeter rival metrics.
reversal_observations: A future official same-perimeter disclosure shows that the FY2015-FY2017 adjusted-profit series is not comparable after business or consolidation-boundary changes.
A future official disclosure shows receivable, inventory, and operating-cash conversion improving sufficiently to reduce debt dependence.
A future official disclosure attributes the FY2017 disposal gain or project commitments to recurring operating economics differently from the current treatment.

component_treatments.reason: The disclosed multimedia, white-goods, mobile, and supply-chain activities are recurring businesses, but only consolidated adjusted net profit is supplied and it remains negative across FY2015-FY2017; no component cash, margin, or maintenance-capital bridge is disclosed.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Permits only conditional enterprise recurring-earnings and owner-cash treatment; it does not establish a standalone component value input.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Obtain same-perimeter component revenue, margin, operating-cash, working-capital, and maintenance-versus-growth-capital disclosures over a comparable period.

component_treatments.reason: FY2017 consolidated operating cash flow was negative and attributed to receivables and unexpired bills, while receivables, inventories, and short-term borrowings were high; the source expressly does not allocate those balances or flows among businesses.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Prevents a base owner-cash range and leaves the financing-loss path unresolved rather than assigning it to an operating component.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Obtain comparable component-level receivable, inventory, operating-cash, borrowing, and cash-conversion disclosures that reconcile to the consolidated accounts.

component_treatments.reason: FY2017 reported profit includes a stated non-sustainable investment gain from disposal, and named projects have only consolidated project inputs or preparation status without television/display attribution, cash funding, or return evidence.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Excludes disposal gain and unproven project-capital return from primary recurring economics and owner cash.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Demonstrate recurring operating contribution, attributable funding, and subsequent return on each material project with a same-perimeter cash and capital bridge.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Same-perimeter component earnings and owner-cash evidence establishes a recurring range and distinguishes maintenance from growth-capital commitments.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Official comparable disclosures show that the consolidated adjusted-profit series cannot represent recurring operations after perimeter, mix, or accounting changes.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Component-level cash-conversion and funding disclosures reconcile receivables, inventories, operating cash flow, and borrowings over a comparable period.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Official disclosure shows the consolidated cash deficit or debt balances are not economically connected to the disclosed working-capital movements.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Project-level recurring cash generation and return on attributable capital are evidenced after separating disposal proceeds from operating cash.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Official evidence establishes that the FY2017 disposal gain is recurring operating income or that project commitments have no material capital consequence.

basis.metric: Consolidated adjusted net profit attributable to owners
basis.operating_perimeter: Consolidated company and controlled subsidiaries; no component allocation is supplied.

quantification.reason: The supplied series gives consolidated adjusted net profit but no sanctioned same-perimeter normalized recurring-earnings range, component margin bridge, or maintenance-capital bridge.
quantification.conservative_treatment: Retain recurring normal earnings as conditional and do not set a point estimate or base range.

rows.economic_reason: Adjusted profit removes disclosed non-recurring items but remains a consolidated and loss-making reference rather than a demonstrated normal recurring earnings level.

quantification.reason: The source identifies the non-sustainable disposal gain and named project inputs but does not supply an attributable, recurring, after-tax project-return bridge.
quantification.conservative_treatment: Exclude disposal and project-capital effects from recurring normal earnings rather than convert them into a recurring contribution.

rows.economic_reason: A stated non-sustainable disposal gain and unallocated project commitments cannot establish recurring operating earnings.

driver_sensitivity_specs.metric: Consolidated adjusted net profit attributable to owners

low.basis: FY2015 disclosed consolidated adjusted net profit attributable to owners.

base.basis: FY2016 disclosed consolidated adjusted net profit attributable to owners.

high.basis: FY2017 disclosed consolidated adjusted net profit attributable to owners.

normal_earnings.basis: The three consolidated observations do not distinguish component mix, recurring operating margin, consolidation-boundary changes, or maintenance-capital needs.

delta.reason: No same-perimeter component-level evidence supports a quantified translation from the reported adjusted-profit history to normal earnings.
delta.conservative_treatment: Do not derive a normal-earnings delta or base range from this history.

owner_cash.basis: Operating cash was separately disclosed only on a consolidated basis and moved adversely in FY2017 with receivable and bill increases.

delta.reason: The permitted disclosures do not reconcile adjusted profit to component working capital, maintenance capital, or owner cash.
delta.conservative_treatment: Do not derive an owner-cash delta or base range from this profit history.

driver_sensitivity_specs.responsibility_boundary: Consolidated enterprise only; the disclosed operating businesses do not have separately allocated earnings, cash, working-capital, or borrowing evidence.

evidence_trace.used_for: Define recurring-operations perimeter and establish the absence of a component-level economic bridge.

evidence_trace.scope: FY2015-FY2017 consolidated revenue, reported net profit, and adjusted net profit attributable to owners.
evidence_trace.used_for: Set the conditional recurring-operations reference and the three disclosed sensitivity input cases.

evidence_trace.scope: Consolidated operating cash flow, long-lived-asset spending, receivables, inventories, and the FY2017 explanation for negative operating cash flow.
evidence_trace.used_for: Identify unresolved working-capital and owner-cash exposure.

evidence_trace.locator: 现金、营运资本、债务与受限资产的原始事实；FY2015 p. 18, FY2016 p. 19, FY2017 p. 21; 具名项目、收购/处置与融资边界；FY2017 p. 88
evidence_trace.scope: Consolidated short- and long-term borrowings and FY2017 gross borrowing inflows and debt repayments.
evidence_trace.used_for: Describe financing pressure without allocating it to a business component.

evidence_trace.locator: 跨期经营与利润资料；FY2017 年报 PDF p. 12, p. 20; 具名项目、收购/处置与融资边界；FY2017 p. 188
evidence_trace.scope: FY2017 disclosed property-disposal investment gain, stated non-sustainability, related non-recurring item, and disposal cash-flow facts.
evidence_trace.used_for: Exclude disposal effects from recurring normal earnings and owner cash.

evidence_trace.locator: 具名项目、收购/处置与融资边界；FY2017 年报 PDF p. 22; 明确 UNKNOWN
evidence_trace.scope: Named projects, disclosed consolidated inputs/preparation status, and the explicit absence of television/display-attributable project cash spending or financing balances.
evidence_trace.used_for: Exclude unproven project-capital returns from the base.

underwriting_thesis.central_path: The pre-cutoff record supports a conditional, not base, recurring-enterprise assessment: adjusted earnings stayed negative despite reported FY2017 profit, while cash conversion and funding pressure are unresolved at the component level.
underwriting_thesis.normal_earnings_treatment: Keep normal earnings conditional and unquantified; do not treat the FY2017 disposal-driven reported profit as recurring.
underwriting_thesis.owner_cash_treatment: Do not form a base owner-cash range because operating cash, working capital, long-lived-asset spending, and borrowing are only consolidated and FY2017 operating cash was negative.
underwriting_thesis.permanent_loss_treatment: Retain an unresolved cash-conversion and financing path, and exclude non-recurring disposal/project effects from the base loss analysis.
underwriting_thesis.value_route_treatment: Use only the conditional recurring-enterprise model role; the disposal/project route is excluded and the financing route remains unresolved.
underwriting_thesis.strongest_rival: UNRESOLVED: the permitted source package identifies no named rival or same-perimeter rival metrics.
underwriting_thesis.monitoring: Monitor official same-perimeter evidence on component earnings, cash conversion, working capital, borrowings, project funding, and the recurring status of disposal-related results.

investment_treatment: Training underwriting classification only; no price, return, valuation result, or investment action is stated.
